study_summary: This study measures investor attitudes toward digital gold, focusing on security, transparency, and government affiliation, while exploring how digital gold fits into their broader investment strategies.

discovery.study_domain_observed: This study explores investor attitudes toward digital gold, focusing on security, transparency, and government affiliation. Respondents discuss their investment strategies, balancing traditional assets like gold and mutual funds with newer options like crypto, while emphasizing cautious and pragmatic approaches.

benchmark_confidence_valid.description: False if respondent favourably compares the product to SGB (or another benchmark) while their gold_behavior.sgb_awareness is none or name-only — a comparison to a benchmark they cannot describe is false confidence, not a valid comprehension signal.
benchmark_confidence_valid.scoring_rule: AMBIGUITY RULE 4: SGB comparison made + sgb_awareness none/name-only = false. Otherwise true. Null if no benchmark comparison made.

trial_motivation.description: Whether a stated small-amount trial (e.g. an initial deposit to test) is framed as testing the platform/app itself, versus genuine conviction in the product/yield mechanic. These require different follow-up communication strategies.
trial_motivation.scoring_rule: AMBIGUITY RULE 6: trial framed as just to try the app = platform_trial. Framed as to test if the yield actually works = product_conviction. No trial mentioned = not_applicable.
